items.description: Map repository modules and integration flow
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/repo_analysis/module_map.md` listing every non-vendor module (`.archivara/*.py`, `.opencode/tools/*.ts`, `.opencode/agents/*.md`, root docs, `results/`, `figures/`) with purpose, inputs, outputs, and at least one connection arrow per module.

items.description: Define the core research problem and measurable goals
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/repo_analysis/problem_statement.md` with one primary objective, 3 research questions, and 4 success metrics (energy drift, angular momentum drift, orbit error, runtime per step) including target thresholds.

items.description: Run web-based literature and code repository search
items.acceptance_criteria: Execute at least 3 web searches covering papers, open-source implementations, and state-of-the-art methods; record queries/results in `results/literature/search_log.md` with >=15 shortlisted sources (>=10 papers and >=3 code repositories).

items.description: Create and maintain citation database in sources.bib
items.acceptance_criteria: Add `sources.bib` in repo root with at least 10 valid BibTeX entries for consulted works; `results/literature/literature_review.md` cites at least 10 BibTeX keys and summarizes relevance of each source.

items.description: Delegate literature exploration and synthesis to subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Use one subagent for citation-graph exploration and a second subagent for synthesis; store outputs in `results/literature/subagent_phase1/` and produce `results/literature/subagent_phase1/synthesis.md` containing >=5 citation chains and >=3 transferable techniques.

items.description: Specify baseline simulator architecture and reproducibility contract
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/baseline/design_spec.md` defining state schema, units, force law, softening policy, fixed-step integrator, deterministic seed strategy, CLI contract, and explicit dependencies on phase 1 artifacts.

items.description: Implement deterministic O(N^2) Newtonian baseline
items.acceptance_criteria: Baseline run completes for two-body and N-body smoke tests, writing `results/baseline/trajectories/*.json`; repeated runs with identical seed produce identical output hashes.

items.description: Build baseline metric collection pipeline
items.acceptance_criteria: Generate `results/baseline/metrics.json` and `results/baseline/metrics.md` with at least 5 metrics: energy drift %, angular momentum drift %, center-of-mass drift, mean step time, and memory usage for N={16,64,256}.

items.description: Perform concept-tree exploration for baseline dependency mapping
items.acceptance_criteria: Ensure `results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json`, `results/concept_evolve/tree/adjacency.json`, and `results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json` exist, and annotate at least 3 concept folders with baseline dependency notes in folder-level `README.md` files.

items.description: Delegate baseline gap exploration and synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate one subagent to explore baseline failure/gap patterns and another to synthesize priorities; deliver `results/baseline/subagent_gap_report.md` with >=5 ranked gaps and explicit links to downstream phase items.

items.description: Select research methods using literature and concept-tree evidence
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/research/approach_selection.md` comparing at least 3 methods (for example symplectic integration, Barnes-Hut, adaptive time stepping) on stability, complexity, implementation risk, and literature support with >=2 citations per method from `sources.bib`.

items.description: Implement and evaluate symplectic integration variant
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/research/symplectic_eval.json` showing at least 20% lower median energy drift than baseline on at least 2 scenarios while keeping runtime within 1.5x baseline.

items.description: Implement scalable force approximation approach
items.acceptance_criteria: Implement one scalable force strategy (Barnes-Hut or equivalent) and write `results/research/scaling_eval.json` demonstrating throughput improvement over baseline for N>=512 plus an error-vs-speed tradeoff curve.

items.description: Derive a hybrid hypothesis from concept-tree walk and probe
items.acceptance_criteria: Use concept-tree outputs to create `results/concept_evolve/tree/hybrid_proposal.md` that references at least one walk path of length >=3, defines a hybrid method, and specifies one concrete experiment seed with dependencies.

items.description: Delegate cross-approach exploration and ablation synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate one subagent for failure-case exploration and another for ablation synthesis; store artifacts in `results/research/subagent_phase3/` and produce `results/research/subagent_phase3/ablation_plan.md` with >=4 ablations and expected signals.

items.description: Define experiment matrix and preregister protocol
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/experiments/protocol.md` defining methods, N values, dt values, and >=5 seeds across scenarios (two-body analytic, three-body chaotic, random N-body), including stopping criteria and metric computation rules.

items.description: Execute controlled experiment matrix
items.acceptance_criteria: Store raw outputs in `results/experiments/raw/` with a run manifest containing command, seed, method, runtime environment, and commit hash; each method-scenario pair includes at least 5 seeded runs.

items.description: Compare results against prior work from literature review
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/experiments/prior_work_comparison.md` comparing against at least 5 prior works identified in phase 1, including citation keys from `sources.bib`, metric alignment notes, and where direct comparison is not possible.

items.description: Perform statistical analysis and robustness checks
items.acceptance_criteria: Publish `results/experiments/statistics.md` with confidence intervals, effect sizes vs baseline, and sensitivity analysis for dt and softening; explicitly report pass/fail against thresholds defined in item_002.

items.description: Delegate independent evaluation audit and synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Use one subagent to reproduce a sampled experiment and another to synthesize audit findings; deliver `results/experiments/subagent_audit.md` with a reproducibility checklist and resolved action items.

items.description: Synthesize final findings into evidence-backed claims
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/final/findings.md` with at least 4 claims; each claim references one quantitative artifact, one figure path, and at least one citation key from `sources.bib`.

items.description: Assemble technical documentation and reproducibility package
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/final/reproducibility.md` with setup instructions, run commands, configuration table, and artifact index sufficient for a fresh user to execute baseline plus one advanced method in <=30 minutes.

items.description: Document limitations, threats to validity, and risks
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/final/limitations.md` including at least 8 limitations, at least 3 threats to validity, and mitigation proposals mapped to future work dependencies.

items.description: Run concept-tree retrospective and future dependency roadmap
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/concept_evolve/tree/retrospective.md` that references at least 5 concept folders and prioritizes the top 10 follow-up experiments with explicit prerequisites and expected signals.

items.description: Delegate final exploration-synthesis review and closeout
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate one subagent for final exploratory critique and another for synthesis/editing; store `results/final/subagent_closeout.md` with at least 10 actionable comments and a checklist verifying cross-links across all phase artifacts.
